question: How can I control my character effectively in Stickman School Run as a beginner?
answer: In Stickman School Run, controlling your character effectively is crucial. Additionally, pay attention to the timing of your swipes to avoid obstacles smoothly. Remember, mastering these basic controls will set a strong foundation for more advanced gameplay.
